title: The Tide of Sandpiper Point
author: Wren Galloway
blurb: Coral Ravensworth, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
